# VEXI

> VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial. A demo runs in your browser with no account.

## Product

- [Home](https://vexi.app/): Say it. It's made.
- [Features](https://vexi.app/features): Ask for content, get it made, and let Autopilot post it.
- [Just Ask](https://vexi.app/features#just-ask): Type what you want. It comes back finished.
- [AI Autopilot](https://vexi.app/features/autopilot): It writes it, designs it and puts it out.
- [Design Editor](https://vexi.app/features#design-editor): Tap anything on the design to change it.
- [Image To Video](https://vexi.app/features#image-to-video): One still becomes a moving clip.
- [Video Editing](https://vexi.app/features#video-editing): One long video. The best clips back.
- [Like This Video](https://vexi.app/features#reference-style): Show it a video you like.
- [Script + Teleprompter](https://vexi.app/features#script-teleprompter): Read. Record. Ship.
- [Trending Ideas](https://vexi.app/features#trending-ideas): Know what people are searching.
- [Analytics](https://vexi.app/features#analytics): Numbers that tell you what to do next.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://vexi.app/pricing): Three plans from $199/month. Every plan starts with 15 days.
- [Creator, $199/mo](https://vexi.app/pricing#plan-creator): Social media, handled.
- [Pro, $399/mo](https://vexi.app/pricing#plan-pro): Everywhere, every day.
- [Max, $599/mo](https://vexi.app/pricing#plan-max): Your own media company.
